Admission runs through a license a state issues to one person. At join the applicant submits a commission number; the node reads the state licensing feed, requires the name to match the wallet, and refuses a second key on the same number.

One costs a 60 dollar exam fee, a background check and a 30 day wait, since it sits monthly. All in near 150 dollars, so fifty clones run 7,500 dollars, and a forgery breaks at the first refresh.

An anchor holds because someone paid for the chain; a basalt ledge holds because the lava under it cooled slowly; a commission is worth only the name on it.
